# Check WWW, HTTPS and query redirects with Apify

For website operators verifying a domain or CDN change. This template generates eight URL variants per existing path with the EcomOpsKits Actor, waits for that one run, checks result completeness, and returns pass/review/fail/unknown counts plus observed chains. It changes no website settings and sends no messages.

## Setup
1. Set your public HTTPS origin and 1–10 existing paths. Never enter secrets or personal data in URLs.
2. Create an **HTTP Header Auth** credential with name `Authorization` and value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`. Select that credential on all five HTTP nodes. Never paste a token in the workflow JSON.
3. Review the Actor pricing, then set `acknowledgePaidRun` to true and run manually. Each new execution can incur another charge.

## Cost and recovery
Template is free; Apify usage and your n8n hosting are separate. Actor price is USD0.002/non-unknown check, maximum USD0.016/path at this price. Platform cap is USD0.16/run. Failures can be billable. No automatic paid retry. After interruption, inspect Apify Console and paste its run ID into `existingRunId` to read that run instead of starting another. Keep the original site/path settings.

## Limits
Public HTTP GET only; no browser rendering, indexing, analytics or site changes. Unknown results are not a pass. Manual trigger only; no schedule or external notification. Results remain in your Apify storage and n8n execution history.

Built by EcomOpsKits, the Actor publisher: https://apify.com/ecomopskits/www-https-query-redirect-checker

## Start or recover one run

New runs require explicit spending consent and are capped at USD0.16. For recovery, use an existing run ID with the original origin and paths. Recovery reads that run; it does not restart it.

## Wait for the same run

Polling follows one run ID. It never starts an automatic paid retry. Failed or unfinished runs stop with an error rather than reporting a successful check.

## Validate the result

Original input must match the selected origin and ordered paths. Summary, rows and expected checks must agree. Partial output fails; unknown checks never count as passes. Read the returned counts and individual redirect chains.
